about.text: it can only be found in Talesh County. this cheese is made from goat or sheep milk. Once the cheese is processed, it is held in sheep or goat skin for aging and preservation.

sources.text: Iranian (Gilan/Talesh) cheese; skin-ripening and type could not be verified online, treat as unconfirmed
